notes: Amendment bill; sole registered source is the Introduced-in-House text (67 lines, 2398 chars); no referencedSources. The analysis is faithful to that source: it amends FLSA Section 3(o) (29 U.S.C. 203(o)) to add a new 3(o)(2) excluding from 'hours worked' any time attending or participating in lectures/education/training and similar activities, regardless of whether offered or facilitated by the employer, provided (A) outside regular working hours, (B) voluntary with no adverse effect on employment for non-attendance, and (C) no productive work for the employer; it retains the clothes-changing/CBA exclusion as 3(o)(1) and applies to hours worked on or after enactment. All operative figures, entities, directions (exclude/voluntary/no-productive-work) and coverage of both sections verify against source; no direction inversions; no material coverage omissions. Minor items (6): (1) 'minimum-wage and overtime' in sections[1].detail is a correct-but-extrinsic gloss of 'sections 6 and 7' (source never names those sections) — the sole UNSUPPORTED-substance row; (2) 'paid'/'Not Paid Time' in summary + headline glosses exclusion from FLSA sec 6-7 hours worked (accurate); (3-5) likelihoodReason stage/vote framing (Failed 2026-01-13, 209-215, 'ends progress') is votes[]-metadata, consistent with cache but not in bill text (rubric class 8). CAVEATS: (a) top_lines subs[1] drops 'facilitated' from 'offered or facilitated by the employer' — faithful, noted. (b) Version currency: a 'Reported in House' (2025-12-30) version exists and the cache versionChanges flags reworded (B)/(C) conditions, but the REGISTERED source file is the Introduced text and the substantive analysis tracks that Introduced language — so the analysis is source-faithful; versionChanges itself describes the RH text (not in the registered source) and was out of scope for this source-only audit.
